claim_provenance.claim: The report records more than 112.1 billion app downloads in 2025, reported as having occurred rather than as a forecast.
The report records more than 112.1 billion app downloads in 2025.
In 2025, consumer spending in the mobile-app market rose 10.6% year over year to $167 billion.
In 2025, global e-commerce app installs fell 10% year over year while sessions rose 5%; global finance app installs fell 4% while sessions rose 21%.

Globally, gaming app growth from 2024 to 2025 varied by subvertical: Casual installs grew 19% and sessions 37%; Strategy sessions grew 57% while installs declined 1%; Casino installs grew 22% while sessions declined 5%; and Slots installs grew 46% while sessions declined 5%.

The report recommends that app marketers use an integrated, adaptable, and accountable data foundation combining cross-channel attribution, AI insights, and next-generation solutions for campaign optimization and budget allocation based on aggregated data.
